_eligibility_text:
A student should fulfill the following criteria to be eligible for this Scholarship:

   1. State Agriculture Scholarship will be applicable for all the inhabitants of Nagaland pursuing for B.Sc. or M.Sc. Agriculture.
   1. The applicant must be from an Institution which has a valid AISHE/UDISE code.
   1. Students who have failed in their last examination (repeaters) are not eligible to apply.
   1. Applicants must not be a beneficiary of any other scholarship scheme.
